name: Home loan rates (RBI repo rate)
title: RBI repo rate and home loan rates: latest change
summary: The Reserve Bank's repo rate, which moves floating home loan rates, and what banks did after the last change.
means: On a floating-rate loan, ask your bank when the new rate applies to you and whether it changes your EMI or your tenure.

history.status: The RBI raised the repo rate by 0.25 percentage point to 5.50%. Several banks, among them PNB and Bank of Baroda, raised their home loan rates after it.
